message.content: {"text":" Check the dropdown/popover positioning logic and any recent responsive CSS or Floating UI/Popper configuration changes. Verify that the menu uses viewport-aware collision detection, flipping, or shifting rather than a fixed left/right offset.\n\nTo confirm the fix, open Open WebUI in a narrow mobile viewport or resize the browser, then trigger dropdowns near both screen edges. The menu should shift inward or flip as needed, remain fully within the viewport, keep all option labels readable, and still allow every option to be selected without horizontal scrolling or clipping."}
